text:
Jake AE: Hey team — handing off account Lumina Health (Enterprise) post-sign. Key context: signed last Friday, PV=500k tokens/mo, require SSO + private eval, target go-live in 6 weeks. Renewal window 11mo. Sales notes: eval found latency spikes on long queries; they want canary for private deploy. Also they flagged security questionnaire items 3 & 7.

Maria CSM: Thanks Jake. Taking point on onboarding. Quick questions: who owns SSO setup on our side? also can we get the eval dataset + failing prompts?

Jake AE: @Lin will own SSO config assist. I'll upload the eval prompts to the shared folder: https://redwood-internal/drive/lumina-eval

Lin Support: Got it. I'll start with SAML metadata exchange. Ping me if they want on-prem certs. I saw the latency notes — @Maria can you share top 10 slow prompts so we can repro?

Maria CSM: Uploading now. Also logging an enablement session request for their ML infra team.

Priya Enablement: Happy to run the enablement workshop. Proposed agenda: 1) onboarding checklist 2) SSO walkthrough 3) best practices for batching/cache 4) rollback playbook. Available weeks of Apr 4 or Apr 11. Which works for Lumina?

Jake AE: Lumina prefers Apr 11. Can we do morning US-PST? they said `preferred_time: 09:00 PDT`.

Maria CSM: Blocking items before workshop: SSO configured, private deployment plan, and baseline perf numbers. Owners listed inline below.

ops-bot: Runbook created: /runbooks/lumina-onboarding (ticket #CS-8421)

Jake AE: Owners: SSO -> Lin, Private deploy plan -> Lin + Eng infra, Workshop -> Priya, CS lead -> Maria, Support escalations -> Lin, Renewal owner -> Jake (I'll track commercial items). Risks: if we miss go-live SLA by 2 wks, they indicated potential refund clause. Flagging as medium-high.

Maria CSM: Action items (short):
• Lin — start SAML metadata exchange and share test endpoints by 1876547000
• Priya — draft workshop slide deck and send invite by 1876550000
• Jake — share contract clause re: refund + exec sponsor contact
• Maria — run pre-workshop perf baseline and share traces

Lin Support: Acknowledged. I'll open a support ticket for reproducing latency with trace context and assign to eng-runtime if native repro fails.

Priya Enablement: I'll draft deck. Do you want a short pre-read for the Lumina platform team? keeps session efficient.

Jake AE: Yes please add a 15-min pre-read.

Maria CSM: I'll coordinate invites. Also adding a customer note: they want weekly sync for first 4 weeks after go-live.

Lin Support: If we hit infra blocker, suggest canary on hosted -> dedicated path fallback plan. I'll work with eng-infra to prep autoscale rules.

Jake AE: Thanks all. I'll do a 1:1 with Lumina's CTO tomorrow and confirm exec sponsor. Will update thread with any contract nuance.

Maria CSM: Great — I'll create the onboarding milestone checklist in CS tool and link here. Tagging @ops-bot for runbook updates.

ops-bot: Runbook updated with milestones and owners: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/lumina-onboarding#milestones :white_check_mark:

Lin Support: FYI — created internal ticket ENG-4152 for quantization check to address latency; assigned to @eng-runtime. ETA 5 business days.

Jake AE: Noted. Closing handshake for sales -> CS handoff. Maria, Lin — can you confirm once SSO test completes so I can announce to customer?

Maria CSM: Will confirm. Thanks everyone :pray:
